metadata.title: Arab Futures Society
metadata.description: A collective of Arab futurists, foresight practitioners, and researchers united to ensure Arab futures are imagined, shaped, and owned by Arabs.

hero.title: Futures by Arabs, for Arabs
hero.slogan: A collective of Arab futurists, foresight practitioners, and researchers united to ensure Arab futures are imagined, shaped, and owned by Arabs.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: We exist to build a foresight ecosystem that speaks our language, reflects our diversity, and reclaims our agency in shaping tomorrow.
about.breakoutDescription: We believe foresight is not only a discipline but a cultural right: the right to imagine futures on our own terms.

participatory.label: Participatory
participatory.value: Fostering inclusion and collective ownership of the future.

agency.label: Agency
agency.value: Empowering individuals and institutions to shape their own trajectories.

representation.label: Representation
representation.value: Ensuring Arab futures are told by Arab voices.

pioneering.label: Pioneering
pioneering.value: Driven to challenge, adapt, and create what our region needs.

features.label: FOR CONTEXT
features.heading: Localizing Tools
features.description: Adapting and developing foresight tools and frameworks to align with Arab contexts, mindsets, and languages.

features.label: FOR CULTURE
features.heading: Researching Futures
features.description: Investigating cultural and social futures, amplifying local narratives of change, and advancing Arab contextual foresight.

features.label: FOR CAPACITY
features.heading: Building Skills
features.description: Strengthening regional capabilities through targeted training, education, and collaboration across all sectors.

features.label: FOR ACTION
features.heading: Guidance & Innovation
features.description: Consulting and speaking to guide institutions, policymakers, and innovators toward future-oriented action.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the leading platform for foresight excellence in the region, cultivating leadership, ethical innovation, and futures literacy grounded in Arab values to shape meaningful, just, and regenerative futures.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To build and democratize foresight capacity across the Arab world by developing context-rooted tools, nurturing practitioners, and making futures thinking accessible, relevant, and actionable for all.

features.label: Flagship Initiative
features.heading: The Arab Futures Lexicon
features.description: For decades, futures terminology has been scattered across translations and institutions, creating barriers for researchers and policymakers. This initiative creates a living, collaborative, and authoritative reference for Arabic foresight terminology, serving as both a knowledge base and a community platform.

featuredTerms.title: Featured Terms
featuredTerms.description: Explore a curated selection of key terms from the Arab Futures Lexicon. Each term is a gateway to understanding the evolving language of foresight in our region.

contact.title: Let's Shape the Future Together
contact.description: Whether you are a researcher, a policymaker, a student, or a practitioner, your voice is essential. Connect with us to collaborate, learn more, or join the conversation.

collaborate.title: Collaborate on Research
collaborate.description: Partner with us on projects that advance Arab cultural and contextual foresight.

learn.title: Learn & Grow
learn.description: Inquire about our capacity-building workshops, training, and educational programs.

speak.title: Speaking & Consulting
speak.description: Invite us to guide your institution or speak at your event on future-oriented action.

join.title: Join the Community
join.description: Become part of our network of futurists and practitioners shaping tomorrow.
